s.how: Shape 500g beef mince into 12 small patties and season. Cook on a hot pan for 2 minutes a side, adding half a cheese slice each at the end. Put in 12 slider buns with pickles and sauce.
Cut 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks, 1 cucumber and 1 red capsicum into sticks and stand them in jars. Blitz 200g sour cream with parsley, chives and a squeeze of lemon for the dip.

m.how: Toss 800g chicken thigh with 2 tbsp chipotle in adobo, garlic and lime, grill and slice. Serve in 12 small tortillas with 2 sliced avocados, shredded lettuce, coriander and lime wedges.

w.note: the neon of the dance floor
w.how: Crush 150g biscuits with 60g melted butter into 6 glasses. Beat 250g cream cheese, 80g icing sugar and 150g mashed strawberries, fold in 200ml whipped cream and spoon on top. Chill 2 hours and top with a strawberry.

d.how: Shake 40ml vodka, 15ml orange liqueur, 30ml cranberry juice and 10ml lime juice with ice for each glass. Strain into 4 chilled glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
